definitions.explanation: The collective term for all employees at an educational institution, including both teachers and administrative or support staff.

examples.japanese: {教職員|きょうしょくいん}{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a training session for the teaching staff.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教職員|きょうしょくいん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧⟦{五十|ごじゅう}→五十：00930_gojuu⟧{名|めい}だ。
examples.english: This school has about fifty faculty and staff members.

examples.japanese: {教職員|きょうしょくいん}⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{最優先|さいゆうせん}→最優先：13012_saiyuusen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}えている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: All faculty and staff consider student safety their top priority.

notes:
USAGE:
{教職員|きょうしょくいん} combines ⟦{教員|きょういん}→教員：12942_kyouin⟧ (teaching staff) and ⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧ (administrative staff) into a single collective term. It is used in official and institutional contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{教員|きょういん}→教員：12942_kyouin⟧ — teachers only
- ⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧ — non-teaching staff only
- {教職員|きょうしょくいん} — both teachers and staff combined
- ⟦{教師|きょうし}→教師：03029_kyoushi⟧ — teacher (more general, less institutional)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教職員|きょうしょくいん}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧ (faculty meeting)
- {教職員|きょうしょくいん}⟦{組合|くみあい}→組合：02669_kumiai⟧ (teachers' union)
- {教職員|きょうしょくいん}⟦{一同|いちどう}→一同：08918_ichidou⟧ (all faculty and staff)
